escenas.titulo: The stator stays still; its field rotates

voz.sub: The stator stays still,|but the currents in its three phases|change over time.
voz.tts: The stator stays still,|but the currents in its three phases|change over time.

voz.sub: Each phase produces a magnetic contribution|that pulses along a fixed axis.
voz.tts: Each phase produces a magnetic contribution|that pulses along a fixed axis.

voz.sub: Added together, they form a field that rotates|with constant amplitude.

voz.sub: Under load, this field interacts with the rotor.
